name: Architecture (BS)
school: Taubman College of Architecture and Urban Planning

requirements.label: 121 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BS in Architecture requires a minimum of 121 credits: 61 lower-division (28 general education, 21 pre-architecture, 12 elective) and 60 upper-division. A 2.0 cumulative GPA in required architecture courses is also required and is not auto-checked.

requirements.label: Architecture credits (45)
requirements.hint: A minimum of 45 credits in architecture courses must be earned while enrolled in Taubman College (within 50 total Taubman College credits). Enrollment timing is not tracked; this row counts all ARCH coursework.

requirements.label: Foundational studio modules (6 of 9)
requirements.hint: Any six of the nine half-semester, 2-credit modules over the first two years: ARCH 251 Seeing, 252 Measuring, 253 Scale, 254 Projection, 255 Imaging, 256 Immersion, 257 Assembly, 258 Translation, 259 Orientation. Required architecture courses need a D or better.

requirements.label: ARCH 208: Design Foundations
requirements.hint: The first-year introduction to design thinking and process.

requirements.label: ARCH 313 & 323: History of Architecture I & II
requirements.hint: The two-course architectural history sequence, normally in year two.

requirements.label: First-year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 125 or another course fulfilling the First-Year Writing Requirement.

requirements.label: Humanities electives (6 credits)
requirements.hint: Two humanities courses in the first two years.

requirements.label: Social science electives (6 credits)
requirements.hint: Two social science courses in the first two years.

requirements.label: Natural science elective (3 credits)
requirements.hint: One natural science course beyond the physics requirement.

requirements.label: Calculus I
requirements.hint: MATH 115 (or the honors equivalents) or AP credit.

requirements.label: Physics for Architects
requirements.hint: PHYSICS 121 (Physics for Architects) or the two-course General Physics sequence.

requirements.label: PHYSICS 121 option
requirements.hint: Physics for Architects, 5 credits.

requirements.label: General Physics I & II option
requirements.hint: A two-course general physics sequence (e.g. PHYSICS 140 and 240); take one mechanics course and one electricity & magnetism course.

requirements.label: ARCH 312 & 322: Architectural Design UG1 & UG2
requirements.hint: The third-year studio sequence, 6 credits each. Planning ARCH 312 auto-places ARCH 322 the following winter.

requirements.label: ARCH 317: Construction
requirements.hint: Third-year building construction course.

requirements.label: ARCH 425: Environmental Systems
requirements.hint: Third-year environmental systems course.

requirements.label: ARCH 316 & 326: Theories and Methods I & II
requirements.hint: The third-year theories and methods sequence (also published as Design Fundamentals I & II).

requirements.label: ARCH 432 & 442: Architectural Design UG3 & UG4
requirements.hint: The fourth-year studio sequence, 6 credits each, ending with the Wallenberg Studio. Planning ARCH 432 auto-places ARCH 442 the following winter.

requirements.label: ARCH 314 & 324: Structures I & II
requirements.hint: The fourth-year structures sequence (curriculum Path 1). Path 2 replaces it with two Theories and Methods seminars; if following Path 2, resolve this row with the adjust control.

requirements.label: Architecture elective (3 credits)
requirements.hint: One architecture course beyond the required curriculum, normally in year three.
